[Image: L-shaped polygon]

What is the area, in square cm, of the figure shown above?
figure_description: An L-shaped polygon with six sides. The leftmost vertical side is labeled 8 cm. The bottom horizontal side is labeled 12 cm. From the top-left vertex, a horizontal top edge extends to the right to meet a vertical segment that goes downward, labeled 3 cm. From the bottom of that 3 cm segment, a horizontal edge labeled 9 cm extends to the right to meet the rightmost vertical side. Right-angle symbols are marked at five vertices: the top-left vertex, the vertex where the top horizontal edge meets the 3 cm vertical segment, the vertex where the 9 cm segment meets the right vertical side, the bottom-right vertex, and the bottom-left vertex.
